query: 安全管理体系（ISO 45001） 安全管理体系（ISO 45001） 衡量职业健康安全体系认证覆盖和有效性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：通过了 ISO 45001（或同等 OHSAS 18001）体系认证，且披露了内外部审核频率、安全风险识别机制及具体的职业病预防成效。 • 1分（合格）：建立了内部安全管理制度，具备基础的安全生产操作规程，但尚未获得第三方认证，或认证已过期但仍有管理动作。 • 0分（不合格）：无体系认证且无明确的安全管理制度披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：体系认证覆盖 >80% 的生产场地、实体数量、营业收入或员工人数（即你原始定义的 3分/4分 区间）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对生产部门认证而忽略了物流/行政部门，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关认证覆盖信息。 职业健康安全管理体系 职业病预防 认证覆盖率 安全生产管理体系 ISO 45001 OHSAS 18001 ISO 45001 OHSAS 18001 occupational health and safety management system OHS certification occupational disease prevention certification coverage 企业是否通过ISO 45001或同等OHSAS 18001认证？ 认证机构、证书有效期与认证范围是什么？ 认证覆盖多少生产场地、实体、营收或员工？ 是否披露内外部审核频率？ 是否披露安全风险识别机制及职业病预防成效？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '安全管理体系（ISO 45001）'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否通过ISO 45001或同等OHSAS 18001认证？ 认证机构、证书有效期与认证范围是什么？ 认证覆盖多少生产场地、实体、营收或员工？ 是否披露内外部审核频率？ 是否披露安全风险识别机制及职业病预防成效？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有一般安全生产口号；仅有承包商安全协议而无体系认证/管理制度；仅有事故率数字而无体系说明；仅有消防演练案例；区分：本指标关注企业OHS体系认证与有效性；承包商安全管理关注外包方准入培训监督；ESG数据第三方鉴证不是ISO 45001安全体系认证。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.

results.section: A4: Climate Change / B. SOCIAL
results.text: In line with the rapid development of the Group's business, human resources management and the recruitment of talents are of particular importance to the Group. The Group regularly analyses the existing remuneration system and incentive mechanism to optimise the remuneration structure. It ensures employees' remuneration packages are on par with reasonable market rates and stay competitive. Meanwhile, the Group has been expanding recruitment channels, continuously enriching the pool of senior management candidates, stepping up systematic training for employees, providing employees with promotion opportunities, broadening their career prospects, and encouraging the good corporate culture.

The coal gasification is used by the Group to eliminate outdated equipment, in a bid to generate clean energy for production.
